mentions.name: KiCad in the browser
mentions.description: A browser port of KiCad, the open-source electronics design suite, compiled to WebAssembly with an updated WxWidgets port and ~200 tests supporting all the features KiCad needs. In-progress work adds multithreading via web workers using Emscripten's asyncify (currently debugging a race condition where the main thread spins waiting for workers), and a planned collaboration layer using yjs so multiple people can edit the same PCB through pcbnew's plugin system, plus handling KiCad's lack of automatic file-change syncing; the schematic and component editors still need a sync solution.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on porting KiCad to the browser. It's a lot of sweat and tears, multithreading issues and some more sweat. I've updated a port of WxWidgets and now I support all the features KiCad needs with ~200 tests.
